text:
maria_csm: Hi team 1 kicking off Luminary Health onboarding. They're planning Redwood Private in their AWS account for PHI. Target go-live: ~7 weeks. Proposed internal owners: Maria (CSM), Ben (SE), Anya (Ops), Tariq (Enablement), Sophie (Program). External: Lina (Luminary PM), Raj (Security). Add other owners if needed.

maria_csm: Draft success criteria:
- VPC peering & private endpoints validated and documented
- SAML SSO + SCIM user provisioning tested end-to-end
- PHI field mapping accepted by Luminary (signed POE)
- Pilot flows show p50 <250ms for 90-95% of requests
- Runbook + two training sessions delivered with recordings

maria_csm: High level timeline:
W0: kickoff, collect SAML metadata, sample payloads, legal contacts
W1-2: infra prep (VPC, SGs, certs, KMS) + basic network tests
W3-4: integration & sample data validation (SE + customer)
W5: pilot canary (10% traffic)
W6: iterate & finalize runbooks
W7: go-live + 30d health check

maria_csm: Early risks: SAML/SCIM metadata delay, unclear PHI mappings, KMS/certs taking extra days, and any contract addenda (BAA).

ben_se: Ill own integration, model mapping, and test harness. Need sample payloads and SAML metadata from Lina. I can produce an integration checklist by Fri.

anya_ops: Ill own VPC connectivity, security groups, and autoscale/batching suggestions. Q for Maria: expected pilot RPS? that affects pool sizes.

tariq_enable: Enablement will run two 75min workshops (dev team + ops), produce quickstart doc + recording, and a one-page runbook summary for oncall.

sophie_pm: Ill track timeline and own the canary plan. Suggest 72h at 10% with automatic rollback to hosted if errors exceed 2% or latency >1s.

maria_csm: Luminary estimates ~60 RPS pilot, ~250 RPS steady. I'll confirm with Lina and post final numbers.

ben_se: That RPS is fine; will design autoscale buffer and recommend KV cache warmup approach.

anya_ops: Noted  Ill draft autoscale policy and network checklist by mid next week.

ben_se: Action: I need sample payloads + SAML metadata by Tue to stay on EOW checklist delivery.

anya_ops: Flags: if customer manages KMS/certs, expect 3-6 business days for cert issuance; HSM integrations add ~1 week. Also request SOC2/BAA items asap.

sophie_pm: Actions from thread:
- Maria: confirm RPS + request SAML/payloads/legal contact (by Tue)
- Ben: integration checklist (EOW)
- Anya: network checklist + autoscale draft (mid next week)
- Tariq: enablement plan + proposed dates (next Thu/Fri)
- Sophie: canary config + rollback playbook (next Wed)

maria_csm: @onboardbot schedule a 60min kickoff with Luminary + internal owners next Tue 11am PT and paste invite here.

onboardbot: Meeting scheduled: Tue 11:00 AM PT 1 60m 1 "Luminary Health: Redwood Private Onboarding Kickoff" Join: https://meet.example.com/luminary (invites sent).

ben_se: :thumbsup: blocking time.

tariq_enable: +1 will prepare agenda and initial slide deck.

anya_ops: Ill add a checklist to the shared drive and link it here once ready.

sophie_pm: Ill spin up the project board and add these action items.

maria_csm: Thanks team  Ill update the thread with artifacts as Lina sends them. If anything changes the timeline, flag it here or DM me. :rocket:
